decisions.reason: Noun identifies edible cooking oil rather than lamp fuel. The rice/oil contrast is idiomatic; the Chinese accurately conveys the almost depleted supply. decisions.reason: Exact closed head clearcut is a forestry area noun in the Canadian official glossary. Chinese correctly limits the definition to recently harvested merchantable trees; two aliases name the area, not the harvesting action. A path following its edge is a natural noun example with faithful Chinese. No clearcutting or clear-cut alias is declared. The separate hyphenated clear-cut canonical adjective remains unchanged; neither old closed-head variant supplies a verified forestry meaning to retain.
